review_notes: I read the whole file. I grepped Mathlib for IdeleGroup, ideleNorm and ideleFiniteCoord. Only Mathlib/NumberTheory/NumberField/AdeleRing.lean matched. It defines IdeleGroup (as an abbrev for the units of the adele ring), unitEmbedding, ofCompletion, ofAdicCompletion, principalSubgroup and IdeleClassGroup. The target file builds on these and does not redefine them. Mathlib has no idele norm or idele-norm section. The only new definitions here are ideleNorm, the private ideleNormAux and ideleNormSection. ideleNormSection is a composition of the existing ofCompletion with completionNormSection from the repo's own Completion/Real file. The ideleFiniteCoord and ideleInfiniteCoord lemmas are simp lemmas about definitions that the repo's Ideles/Basic file supplies. None of Mathlib, Batteries or core has a competing version of them. The helper ideleNormAux is a private, intermediate real-valued function, and ideleNorm is the bundled ℝ≥0ˣ-valued version. This is a deliberate choice and not a duplicate API. I did not check the repo's Ideles/Basic file for internal duplication, and I found no case for consolidation.
